items.text: Ukukholwake kuyikuqiniseka ngezinto ezithenjiweyo, kuliqiniso ngezinto ezingabonwayo.
Abendulo bafakazelwa ngakho emibhalweni.
Ngokukholwa sibona ukuthi umhlaba wenziwa ngelizwi likaNkulunkulu, kuze kuthi okubonwayo kwavela kokungabonwayo.
Gen 1:1
Hubo 33:6
Joha 1:13

Ngokukholwa uAbela wanikela kuNkulunkulu umhlatshelo owamukelekayo kulokaKayini, wazuza ngakho ubufakazi bokuthi ulungile, uNkulunkulu uqobo emfakazela ngokwamukela iziphiwo zakhe; langokukholwa usakhuluma, loba esefile.
Ngokukholwa uEnoki wathathwa ukuze angezwa ukufa; kabe esafunyanwa, ngoba uNkulunkulu wayesemthethe; engakathathwa wafakazelwa ngokuthi umthokozisile uNkulunkulu;
ngaphandle kokukholwa kakwenzeki ukumthokozisa; ngoba ozayo kuNkulunkulu umele ukukholwa ukuthi ukhona lokuthi uyabanika umvuzo labo abamdingayo.
Ngokukholwa uNowa exwayisiwe nguNkulunkulu ngezinto ebezingakabonwa wakha umkolo wokusilisa indlu yakhe; wawulahla umhlaba ngokukholwa, waba yindlalifa yokulunga okuvela ngokukholwa.
Ngokukholwa uAbrahama walalela ebizwa ukuba asuke aye endaweni ayezakuyinikwa ibe yilifa lakhe; waphuma engazi lapho aya khona.
Ngokukholwa wahlala njengomuntu wezizweni elizweni lokuthenjiswa, ehlala emathenteni loIsaka loJakobe ababeyizindlalifa kanye laye zalesosithembiso;
ngoba wayelindele umuzi olezisekelo eziqinileyo, owakhiwa wenziwa nguNkulunkulu.
Ngokukholwa laye uSara uqobo wazuza amandla okuthatha isisu eseluphele, ngoba wathi uthembekile lowo owathembisayo.
Ngakhoke kwavela koyedwa, laye esenjengosewafa, abangangezinkanyezi zezulu ngobunengi, langangesihlabathi esisokhunjini lolwandle esingelakubalwa.
Gen 15:5
Bonke laba bafela ekukholweni, bengamukeliswanga okwathenjiswayo, kodwa bakubonela khatshana, bakuthakazelela, bavuma ukuthi bangabezizwe lezihambi emhlabeni.
Gen 23:4
Hubo 39:12
Ngoba abatsho njalo batshengisa ukuba badinga ilizwe lakibo.
Uba kambe babecabanga ngalelolizwe ababesuke kulo, babelalo ithuba lokubuyela kulo;
kodwake bafisa ilizwe elihle kulalelo okutsho elasezulwini. Ngakhoke uNkulunkulu kalanhloni ngokuthiwa nguNkulunkulu wabo, ngoba ubalungisele umuzi.
Ngokukholwa uAbrahama lapho ehlolwa wanikela ngoIsaka, yebo, yena owayenikwe isithembiso, wavuma ukunikela ngendodana yakhe eyodwa,
okwakuthiwe ngayo: Inzalo yakho izakubizwa ngoIsaka.
Ngoba wathi uNkulunkulu ulamandla okuvusa abantu ekufeni, ngokulinganisa wabuya wayizuza isivela kwabafileyo.
Ngokukholwa uIsaka wabusisa uJakobe loEsawu ngezinto ebezizakuza.
Ngokukholwa uJakobe esezakufa wabusisa lowo lalowo wamadodana kaJosefa, wakhuleka ebambelele ngodondolo lwakhe.
Ngokukholwa uJosefa esezakufa wakhuluma ngokuphuma kwabakoIsrayeli, walayezela ngokungcwatshwa kwamathambo akhe.
Ngokukholwa uMose esezelwe wafihlwa ngabazali bakhe inyanga ezintathu, ngoba bembona engumntwana omuhle, bengawesabi umthetho wenkosi.
Eks 2:2
Ngokukholwa uMose esekhulile wala ukuthiwa uyindodana yendodakazi kaFaro;
wakhetha ukuphathwa kubi kanye labantu bakaNkulunkulu kulokuba athokoze isikhatshana esonweni.
Wathi ukuthukwa ngenxa yoGcotshiweyo kuyinotho enkulu kulamagugu aseGibithe, ngoba wayekhangele umvuzo.
Ngokukholwa wasuka eGibithe, engalwesabi ulaka lwenkosi; ngoba waqinisela kungathi uyambona uNkulunkulu ongabonwayo.
Eks 2:15
Ngokukholwa wamisa iPhasika efafaza igazi, ukuze umbhubhisi wamazibulo angawathinti amazibulo akoIsrayeli.
Ngokukholwa abakoIsrayeli badabula uLwandle oluBomvu kungathi kusemhlabathini owomileyo, okwathi abaseGibithe bekulinga lokho, baminzwa.
Ngokukholwa imiduli yaseJeriko yadilika, isibhodiwe insuku eziyisikhombisa.
Ngokukholwa uRahabi iwule kabhubhanga kanye labangalalelanga, ngoba wazamukela izinhloli.
Josh 2:1–21
Ngisezakuthini na? Ngoba ngingaphelelwa yisikhathi uba ngilandisa ngoGidiyoni, loBaraki, loSamsoni, loJefta, langoDavida langoSamuweli, langabaprofethi,
abathi ngokukholwa banqoba imibuso, basebenza ukulunga, bazuza izithembiso, bavimba imilomo yezilwane,
bacima umlilo ovuthayo, baphepha emkhontweni, bazuza amandla ebuthakathakeni, baba ngamaqhawe empini, baxotsha izimpi zabezizwe.
Abesifazana bamukeliswa abafileyo babo sebevusiwe ekufeni. Abanye bazwiswa ubuhlungu, bengavumi ukukhululwa, ukuze bazuze ukuvuka okuhle.
Abanye benziwa inhlekisa batshaywa, babotshwa ngamaketane, bafakwa entolongweni;
Jer 20:2
bakhandwa ngamatshe, baqunywa ngesaha, babulawa ngomkhonto, bahamba bembethe izigogo zezimvu lezezimbuzi, baswela, bazwiswa ubuhlungu, baphathwa kubi,
umhlaba ungabafanele bona, bazula enkangala lasezintabeni, emihomeni lasezimbalwini zomhlaba.
Bonke labo, lanxa babefakazelwe ngokukholwa, kabakuzuzanga okwathenjiswayo,
lokhu uNkulunkulu wayesibonele thina okuhle kulalokho, ukuze kuthi ngaphandle kwethu bangapheleliswa.
